summary: OceanLight Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (OCLT/OCLTU), filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to combine with AIRE Inc., a Cayman exempted company, alongside Principal Shareholder Everque Limited. The two-step structure has OceanLight merging into wholly owned Purchaser AIRE Global Group Inc., then OCLT Merger Sub Ltd. merging into AIRE, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. Outstanding OceanLight shares, rights and warrants convert one-for-one into Purchaser equivalents. Deal terms, valuation and board recommendation were not stated in the excerpt. Watch redemption levels, warrant treatment and the regulatory/proxy clock.
